newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks end rally, drop on profit-take.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks end rally, drop on profit-take.

text.p: Caracas stocks ended a four day rally falling in a first round of profit-taking that is expected to last into next week, traders said.
"The market's regained some common sense, stocks were over- bought," said Bancaracas broker Simon Brad.
The bolsa's 19-share .IBC index slipped 0.76 percent to end at 6,632.21 points as a fall in telephone company CANTV bruised sentiment, pulling the market lower.
"CANTV's drop stunned the market," said Activalores broker Gonzalo Alonso. The stock closed off three percent at 2,435.00 bolivars, shadowing Wall Street's falls.

Merinvest's composite .MRCP index, which includes CANTV, meanwhile fell 1.3 percent to 105.27 points as 35 million shares traded, worth 5.2 billion bolivars ($10.8 million). Among traded issues 26 fell, 11 rose and six closed flat.
Some brokers saw the profit-take extending into next week, but Alonso said: "I'm still somewhat optimistic ... although next week's performance depends on Wall Street."

Foreign investment houses have continued to recommend the bolsa. On Monday, U.S. bank Morgan Stanley said it saw a 20 percent upside for the market over the rest of the year, the highest in the region.
